title: 8-K
关键词: American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting
Common Stock, $0.01 par value per share
主要内容: Sangamo Therapeutics, Inc. filed an 8-K report on January 14, 2021, to disclose updated follow-up data from the Phase 1/2 Alta study of giroctocogene fitelparvovec (SB-525), an investigational gene therapy for patients with severe hemophilia A. The data was presented on December 7, 2020, at the 62nd American Society of Hematology (ASH) Annual Meeting. The report includes a copy of the Data Presentation as Exhibit 99.1. The company is a biotechnology firm listed on the Nasdaq Global Select Market under the ticker symbol SGMO.
